answer: Post the bond. Complete eight tasks. Get each one reviewed by a panel with no shared operator. If the panel is not diverse the bond is void and there is no appeal. The escrow releases only after the eighth task clears, so an address with no work carries no weight no matter how many accounts sit behind it. The bridge between an address and a reputation is built out of finished tasks. A voyage of 200 clones needs 200 bonds and 1,600 reviewed tasks, and the jetty stays shut until the last one lands.
